international.title: United Airlines says ‘widespread’ system outage resolved
international.summary: Airline acknowledges ‘technology issue that delayed flight departures’ in latest high-profile outage to affect Americans United ⁠Airlines said on ⁠Monday ⁠that it had resolved ⁠a widespread system ⁠outage, just three days after the Federal ⁠Aviation Administration issued a rare nationwide ground stop on all US flights. “We have resolved a technology issue that delayed flight departures. While some flights were delayed, there was no impact on flights in progress, or on United Express flights,” Chicago-based United said in a statement. “There is no indication that this was a cybersecurity-related issue.” Continue reading...
